newsitem.title: MEXICO: Chrysler says Mexico plant not new.
newsitem.headline: Chrysler says Mexico plant not new.

text.p: Chrysler Corp's Mexico unit said Monday that a report by the Mexican government news agency Notimex did not correctly describe its plans for a Chrysler plant in the northern city of Saltillo.
Reuters carred a summary of the Notimex report on Sunday.
The satellite plant, referred to as a new project in the reports, was announced last year and has been under construction since May 1995, Chrysler spokesman Leo Silva said Monday in Mexico City.
It is expected to be operational by the first quarter of next year, he said.
The so-called "stamping plant" will make parts for Chrysler trucks being assembled in the adjacent facility, which was dedicated in April 1995.
"The stamping plant is really part of the truck plant," Silva said.
Saltillo is near the northern industrial city of Monterrey, about 150 miles (240 km) south of Laredo, Texas.
